description: Source code for jemalloc's base memory management module, including functions for mapping, unmapping, and managing memory extents and blocks, as well as handling huge pages and thread-specific data.

methods.name: base_map
methods.description: Maps a memory region, using huge pages and extent hooks, for creating new arenas or memory regions.

methods.name: base_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a memory region, attempting cascade deallocation and handling huge pages.

methods.name: base_extent_init
methods.description: Initializes an extent with a given address, size, and sequence number.

methods.name: base_get_num_blocks
methods.description: Counts the number of blocks in a base structure, optionally including a new block.

methods.name: base_auto_thp_switch
methods.description: Switches the initial blocks to huge pages based on thresholds and auto-thp mode.

methods.name: base_extent_bump_alloc_helper
methods.description: Allocates memory within an extent with alignment, returning a pointer and gap size.

methods.name: base_extent_bump_alloc_post
methods.description: Updates base statistics and heap after bump allocation.

methods.name: base_extent_bump_alloc
methods.description: Performs bump allocation within an extent, updating base info.

methods.name: base_block_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new memory block with size and alignment, possibly using huge pages.

methods.name: base_extent_alloc
methods.description: Allocates an extent with specified size and alignment.

methods.name: b0get
methods.description: Returns the global base object.

methods.name: base_new
methods.description: Creates a new base structure with initial blocks and statistics.

methods.name: base_delete
methods.description: Deletes a base, unmapping all its blocks.

methods.name: base_extent_hooks_get
methods.description: Retrieves the extent hooks associated with a base.

methods.name: base_extent_hooks_set
methods.description: Sets new extent hooks for a base, returning the old ones.

methods.name: base_alloc_impl
methods.description: Allocates memory within a base, using existing extents or creating new ones.

methods.name: base_alloc
methods.description: Allocates zeroed memory with specified size and alignment.

methods.name: base_alloc_extent
methods.description: Allocates an extent object within a base.

methods.name: base_stats_get
methods.description: Retrieves statistics about allocated, resident, mapped memory, and huge pages.

methods.name: base_prefork
methods.description: Prepares a base for a fork operation by locking its mutex.

methods.name: base_postfork_parent
methods.description: Post-fork operations for parent process, unlocking mutex.

methods.name: base_postfork_child
methods.description: Post-fork operations for child process, unlocking mutex.

methods.name: base_boot
methods.description: Initializes the global base object.
